Commentary.Commentary: Now then, 289 is the target! The game is evenly poised at the moment. The West Indies batters do have it in them to chase this down but the Australian pace attack is a threatening one. They too are capable of exploiting the extra bounce on the surface. An exciting chase awaits us.

Man of the moment, Nathan Coulter-Nile, is having a chat with Michael Slater. NCN says that he enjoyed his innings. Assesses the wicket by saying that one needed to take his time and then play his shots. Reckons that the short ball came on pretty quickly off the deck. Admits that he was targetting the shorter side while going big. Hopes that the score is big enough but definitely feels that Australia have a chance at least. Praises his skipper Smith for sticking like a glue in the middle.

The West Indies bowling was fiery to begin with! They used the same tactics they used against Pakistan, bowl short and fast. It did work but they probably overdid it. Also, they weren't as accurate as they were in their last game as they bowled too many extras. Still though on a ground which is know to be a paradise for the batters, they will be happy. Except for Nurse everybody had a wicket at least. Brathwaite was the one with the most wickets as he took a three-fer but Russell was probably the most impressive.

The innings started off for Australia in a very bad fashion as none of Khawaja, Finch, Maxwell or Warner crossed 20. It seemed like the West Indian bowlers would once again bundle their opposition out for a very low total. That was not to be though, as the fightback then began. Smith played the anchoring role, his partnership first with Stoinis steadying the ship a little. The latter fell at the wrong time though but Carey and SS went on to add another 68-run stand. West Indies though were still in control after Carey departed but then what hit them was surely something they would not have been prepared for. Nathan Coulter-Nile! He initially did not look that comfortable but once he got in, he started hitting the bowlers at will. He got his fifty along with Smith and when the two were batting, Australia looked like crossing the 300-run mark. However, Smith was dismissed, courtesy a brilliant catch. Nathan did strike a few meaty blows after that but fell 8 short of a ton. The rest down the order had no significant contribution and Australia fell short of the 300-run mark, failing to bat out their 50 overs.

What a recovery this is from Australia! WOW! They needed something special when they were reeling at 79 for 5 and the lower middle order just provided them that. Their 102-run stand has given Australia a total which they will be very, very pleased with. Yes, they will be disappointed with not facing their hole quota of overs but they will back themselves to defend this target.

OUT! That is the end of the Australian innings! Brathwaite gets the last wicket, second in the over and third overall. Bowls this one full and on middle, Star looks to clear the long on fence but does not get the desired distance. Holder there runs to his left and takes a good catch. AUSTRALIA BOWLED OUT ON 288!
Goes short again and on the body, Starc looks to pull but misses again.
FOUR! Hammered! This time he connects with the short ball and nails it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
OUCH! Short and on the body, Starc looks to pull but misses. Gets hit on the body.
Adam Zampa is the new batsman in.

OUT! Nathan Coulter-Nile holes out! End of an outstanding knock from him. The whole crowd is on its feet and so are the players in the balcony. A well-deserved standing ovation. His innings has taken Australia to a total which is more than defendable. Brathwaite bowls this full and outside off, Coulter-Nile looks to go downtown but does not get it off the middle. It goes high up in the air towards wide long off where Holder takes it.

Poor from Hope! Full and outside off. Coulter-Nile looks to hit it through the off side but it goes off the bottom. Hope looks to stop it with his pads but the ball brushes it and goes towards third man for two.

Another couple! Still, just the 5 runs from this over. A good one for West Indies. Full and on off, Starc hits it towards mid off. The fielder there does not stop it cleanly. He ends up pushing it away from him and an extra run is conceded.
Now a couple! Full and on the pads, this is worked through fine leg and the batters take two.
Just the single from the first 4 balls! Short and on the body, MS looks to pull but it goes off the glove and on the bounce to the keeper.
Another low full toss on off, Coulter-Nile hits it towards long off. He thinks whether he should take a run and then goes for it. He moves into the 90s.
Just short! Two dots though to start the over! Full and outside off, NCN goes after it but the ball hits the outside edge and goes on the bounce to the keeper.
A low full toss outside off, Nathan looks to hit it through covers but gets an inside edge to short fine leg.
Oshane Thomas is back!
Another short ball, Starc is early in the pull, it goes off the bottom part towards the bowler. So a wicket in the over but it goes for 9.
What noise was that? Maybe off the helmet! Short and on the body, Starc looks to pull but misses.
That delivery is difficult to hit! Yorker outside off, Coulter-Nile looks to jam it out but it goes off the inner half down to long off for one.

FOUR! Make that 12! Back-to-back boundaries! The bowlers are just not sure where to bowl to him. Brathwaite bangs it short and it is the slower one. NCN picks it and pulls it through the gap in the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
FOUR! What a shot this is! Full and outside off, Coulter-Nile goes down on one knee and loft it over covers for a boundary. He is 16 short of a ton now.
Mitchell Starc comes out to bat.

OUT! Once again the bowling change does the trick! Short and on middle, Cummins swings hard but across the line. The ball takes the top edge. Goes high up in the air towards deep square leg. Sheldon Cottrell this time takes an easier catch.
Carlos Brathwaite is back!
A single to end another big over! 16 from it. Full and on off, Cummins strokes it towards cover and gets to the other end.
A single now! This is flat-batted down to long off for one.

SIX! Back-to-back maximums! This is longer than the last one, no need to go upstairs for this as the ball has gone there. Full and it is the slower one. NCN lofts it over the long on fence and clears it with ease.

SIX! That has gone all the way! Flat one! What a shot! Shortish and on middle, Coulter-Nile goes back and smashes it right off the middle. It is traveling. Carlos Brathwaite at deep mid-wicket runs to his left, dives full stretch but the ball evades his hand and seems to have gone over the ropes. The umpire goes upstairs to check and after a few replays, the third umpire conveys to the onfield umpire that it's a biggie.
Is that a six or a four? The umpires have gone upstairs to check.
Cummins now plays this late and guides it down to third man for one.
Well fielded by the big man, Gayle! Full and on the pads, Nathan works it towards short fine leg. Gayle dives to his right and saves three.
Three dots to end a successful over for Windies. A yorker on middle, it is kept out.
Another dot! Length and outside off, Cummins looks to cut but misses.
Short and outside off, Cummins evades it.
Shorter and on off, Nathan slaps it down to long on for one.
WIDE! Another one wide outside off, NCN goes after it but misses.
WIDE! Way too wide outside off. Wided.
Pat Cummins is the new batsman. He can tonk a few as well.

OUT! HO, HO, HO! What a catch that is! Probably the catch of the tournament! Cottrell, you beauty! Something  special was needed to break this stand and take Smith's wicket and Sheldon has provided it. Smith can't believe his luck. He might have thought, he has hit that for a biggie. He moves right across and whips it towards the backward square leg fence. SC there runs to his left, stretches one hand out and the ball sticks. He then realizes the momentum is taking him over the ropes so he throws it up, goes over the ropes, then comes back in and completes the catch. The Windies start celebrating. The umpire goes upstairs to check and the replays show it is perfect. The 102-run stand has been broken. And a lovely innings by Smith comes to an end. 300 now looks difficult though.

Sheldon Cottrell has taken a blinder near the fence. But has he done that cleanly? The umpires get together and take it upstairs. Meanwhile, Steve Smith is seen walking. The way West Indians are celebrating they are very sure. Let's find out in the replays...

FOUR! Brilliant start to this over as well! Full and on off, Smith lofts it over mid off for a boundary. Pressure on the bowler now. Brings up the 100-run stand too between the two. They have given Australia a real chance to score above 300.
Oshane Thomas is back on.
A single to end another good over for Australia. 12 from it as Smith comes down the track and pushes it through covers for one.
WIDE! Down the leg side again! Wided.
Nathan now works it through square leg for one.
Over covers! Not right off the middle but wide of long off for a couple.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.

DROPPED! That was hit firmly but still should have been taken. Short and on middle, Nathan goes back and hammers it flat towards deep mid-wicket. Hetmyer there gets two hands to it but spills it. The batters take a run. These need to stick. This partnership is going along really well and Coulter-Nile is getting into his own here.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Coulter-Nile looks to flick but misses. An appeal from the keeper to put the umpire off but he does signal a wide.
FOUR! Cheeky, very cheeky! Moves right across and Nurse fires it on the stumps. NCN uses the pace and paddles it fine on the leg side for a boundary. Ideal start to the over.
Short and outside off, Coulter-Nile goes back and cuts it through backward point for a single. 15 from the over, Australia will be fancying a total near 300 now!
SIX! Coulter-Nile is growing in confidence. Brathwaite delivers one in the slot for the batsman, Nathan lines up the bowler and thumps it over long on for a biggie. Australia are on the charge!

Fifty for Nathan Coulter-Nile, his first in ODIs! What a stage and what a situation to achieve it! Short in length and around off, NCN pulls it over mid-wicket and it falls in no man's land. The fielder in the deep runs across to his right to stop the ball and they take a couple of runs.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Edgy but effective for Australia. Width on offer outside off, Smith goes chasing after it but fails to middle his shot. It gathers the outside edge and runs down to third man for a run.
Wide! 20 runs off wides have come in this innings. Short and down the leg side, Smith shuffles across and allows it through to the keeper.
Good length ball angling into the batsman, Smith turns inside the crease and works it on the leg side. Not in the gap though.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single. Another quiet over by Nurse.
Smith first makes room but Nurse fires it on the stumps. Smith walks in again and works it to mid-wicket.
Floats it up on off, it is hit to covers.

Mix-up but safe in the end! Coulter-Nile works it towards short fine leg. Smith wants a run but NCN is late to start with. He eventually goes for it. The fielder throws it to the bowler who fumbles. No harm done in the end.
Floats it up on the pads, Smith works it through mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Another low full toss, this time it is clipped through square leg for one. 8 runs from the over without any risk taken.
Another single as Smith opens the face and runs it down to third man.
Good length on off, it is guided to point.
Smith pulls out right at the end as there is a plastic bag flying across the ground in the long off region.
Length and outside off, Nathan guides it down to third man for one.
FOUR! Nicely timed! Yes, it is a gift but it has to be put away. A full toss on the pads, NCN flicks it over mid-wicket and bags a boundary.
Full and on off, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Carlos Brathwaite is back on!
Powerplay 3 has been signaled! Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the end of the innings.
Another single as Smith hits this wide of the bowler and down to long on for one.
Well fielded! Saves a single! Full and on middle, Smith hits it to the right of the bowler who dives and stops it.
On the stumps, it is hit back to the bowler.
NCN guides it through backward point for a run. Gayle is the one doing the fielding there and a huge roar from the crowd.
Flatter and outside off, Smith guides it towards backward point for one.
On the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
Ashley Nurse is back on!
Now Russell is walking off the field!
Bowls this one short and Nathan looks to pull but it goes off the top edge, lands well short of fine leg for one.
Russell bails out as he comes to bowl. A long followthrough for him and as he is walking back, he looks in some discomfort. He though seems to be fine to bowl the last ball.
Once again on the pads, Nathan looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.

SIX! The pick up shot and it goes all the way! Consecutive fifty-run stands for Australia. Another very important one but they would hope for this one to continue. Full and on the pads, NCN whips it and it carries over the square leg fence. 200 up for Australia.
A good short one on the body, NCN looks to pull but misses.
Good slower one on middle, Nathan nicely keeps it out.
Nathan guides it towards point. The batters think of a run but then bail out.
Good running! On off, Coutler-Nile plays it late, he gets an inside edge towards the keeper and the batters take a quick run.
Down the leg side, Nathan looks to flick but misses. WIDED!
Back of a length and on the body, Smith works it through square leg for one.
Good punch! Back of a length on off, it is hit through cover-point. The fielder from point and cover go for it. Both don't dive and since it clears the in-field it turns out to be an easy two.
Short and on middle, Smith looks to pull but misses somehow.
Back of a length on off, it is kept out.
Nathan is going after everything full here. It is outside off, Nathan goes hard at it but it takes the inside edge and goes down to fine leg for one.
This time he is in control of the pull shot, hits it all along the ground towards fine leg for one. Another productive over for Australia.
Slower full ball on middle, Nathan swings but it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! Not in control but gets the desired result. Short and on the body, Coulter-Nile looks to pull but does not get it off the middle. It is in the gap and hence, a boundary.

Howzzat? The answer to that question is not out! Russell angles this into the leg pole. Nathan looks to play it with a straight bat but misses to get hit on the pads. A huge shout but the umpire shakes his head. Going down leg, I feel.
Slower one on middle, Smith works it through square leg for one.
Back of a length on off, it is defended.
Direct hit but Smith is in! Full and on middle, SS strokes it to mid on and goes for a single. The fielder hits bull's eye at the non-striker's end but Smith is well in.
Shorter on off from around the wicket. Smith keeps it out.

FOUR! Poor effort in the field helps Smith get to his half ton. His 20th in ODIs. 5th in World Cups. A very hard-working knock by him. He holds the key for his side here. Needs to stay there till the end if Australia are to get to a good score. Length and outside off, Smith looks to cut but it goes off the bottom half towards third man. Russell runs to his left, does not get down in time and the ball sneaks through to cross the fence.
Length and outside off, Smith mistimes it towards cover.
On the bounce! On the body, Smith looks to flick but it goes off the gloves towards Hope who dives to his left and collects it on the bounce. Saves a boundary.
A low full toss on off, NCN jams it out towards point for one.
Sheldon Cottrell is back into the attack.

Almost drags it on! Length and outside off, Coulter-Nile looks to guide it down to third man but the ball is too close to play that shot. An inside edge is produced which hits the pads and rolls on the off side. Smith calls for a run and they take it. 22 from the last two overs. So despite the wickets falling, Australia are managing to score at a good rate.
Well bowled but well played! Maybe he was ready for it as Russell can't bowl any more short balls. A yorker on middle, NCN jams it out.
Lands in no man's land! The slower ball and it is fuller in length, Coulter-Nile swings but does not get it off the middle. He still hits it well enough to get it over mid-wicket for a couple.
Another wide! Short and this one is even more higher than the last one.
WIDE! Goes short again but this one bounces a lot.

FOUR! Top edge and it goes too fine! Short and on the body, Nathan Coulter-Nile looks to pull but is in no control. He still goes for the pull but it hits the top edge and bounces once before the fine leg fence.
Slower one and it is short and outside off, Coulter-Nile waited and then looks to cut it hard but fails to put bat on ball. It goes on the bounce to the keeper who stops it with his pads.
Shortish and outside off, Nathan looks to cut but misses.
A single to end a good over for Australia. 13 from it. Short and on the body, Nathan pulls it towards fine leg for one.

FOUR! In the air... but just wide! Opportunity missed? Pooran probably misjudged it. Down the leg side and it is full. NCN flicks it in the air towards deep backward square leg. Pooran initially runs in straight but then realizes he has to run to his right. He moves to that direction but till then, it is too late as the ball is out of reach and it races to the fence.
On the fuller side on off, Nathan strokes it but straight to mid off.
WIDE! Down the leg side and it has been wided.
Slightly short! Not short enough to make the batter uncomfortable. NCN pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for two.
FOUR! Nathan Coulter-Nile has managed to squeeze that for a boundary! Full and on middle, NCN jams it straight down the ground. The outfield is such that the ball has raced away.
Leading edge but for a run! This is angled into the batter, Smith looks to work it on the leg side but closes the face a touch early. It goes off the leading edge and down to third man for one.
Three now! Nicely played! Slightly fuller and width on offer, Smith strokes it through covers. It is not hit well enough to get to the ropes but three taken.
Bangs it short again, Smith hops and keeps it out.

Our viewpoint - Just a thought. Should Alex Carey be batting a bit higher up the order? We feel that he is batting too low. Ideally, he should be sandwiched between Maxwell and Stoinis so that there is someone down the order to make use of his 'dirty' work. Many times, we have seen Carey come in and do the repair job but after that, there is no one to make use of the platform. Like today. West Indies are into the Aussie bowlers. Had Stoinis or Maxwell come in now, 250-270 could still have been a possibility.
Goes short now and Smith ducks under it.
Very full and on middle, Smith strokes it to mid on.

Well fielded but can't stop the run! Saves three though does the skipper. Full and on off, Coulter-Nile strokes it towards mid off where Holder dives to his left and stops it. 150 up for Australia. They would love to add another 100 or more.
Good length and on off, Nathan guides it towards point.

OUCH! Well played in the end by Smith. Back of a length on off, it rises after pitching. Smith goes back and looks to defend but the ball hits him on the glove. The good thing though, is that he takes a hand off the handle so the ball dies down onto the ground. A very testing over from Oshane.

Top, top bowling! Follows the bouncer with a very full length ball, he also gets it to tail back in. Coulter-Nile looks to jam it out but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls towards the keeper and a run is taken.
Goes short again! This time Coulter-Nile ducks under it confidently.
Once again, it is bowled short to Coulter-Nile and he has a problem. He looks to fend it away but it goes off the leading edge. However, it lands safely near mid-wicket.
Well bowled! A yorker and it tails back in from off. NCN jams it out.
A full toss, Coulter-Nile misses out. He flicks it but finds square leg.
Bowling change. Jason Holder going for the kill here. He has unleashed Oshane Thomas back into the attack.

In the air... safe! Nathan has started off in a very unconvincing manner! Russell hurries him up with a short ball. NCN goes for the pull but gets a top edge towards the leg side. There are two players going for it, the keeper and the mid-wicket fielder, but they don't get to it as the ball falls safely at square leg. Top over for the Windies, a wicket and two runs from it.
OHHH! Brave brave leave! That starts from outside off and comes back in. Coulter-Nile shoulders arms to it. The ball just about kisses the off pole.
Nathan Coulter-Nile is the new batsman in.

OUT! Russell breaks the 68-run partnership. Excellent bowling change by Jason Holder. A wicket almost immediately after the Drinks break and we have seen that happen many times in the past. Not sure though if Carey needed to play at that. It is on a length and outside off, moves away further with the angle. Carey hangs his bat out without any purpose. The ball kisses the outside edge and goes into the mitts of the keeper. A good innings by Carey comes to an end. He will be disappointed though as there was a big opportunity to convert his start. West Indies into the bowling all-rounders now.
This time he gets a single as he pushes it to mid on.
Back of a length on off, defended.
Goes full first up on middle, Smith hits it back towards the bowler. Russell gets down quickly and stops it.
Andre Russell is back into the attack.

DRINKS! The match is shifting like a pendulum from one side to the other. West Indies started the game with a bang, only to witness a fightback, before bouncing back again. However, Steve Smith and Alex Carey have already stitched a 67-run stand and are trying to shift the momentum once more. 20 overs are remaining and West Indies would try to wrap up Australia as quickly as possible.
A quick single to end the 30th! On off, Smith taps it on the off side and takes one.
Very full on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Well fielded! Saves at least two! Short and on off, Carey pulls it hard into the ground. It goes towards mid-wicket where Russell stops it with one hand by diving to his left.
Shorter and on off, Smith guides it through point for one.
This is played with the turn towards the bowler who runs to his right and makes a good stop.
Angles it on off, it is kept out.
Now plays the pull shot through backward square leg. Fine leg runs to his right, dives and saves two.
Well played! Short and on the body, Carey nicely upper cuts it towards third man and takes two. Carey is playing very confidently here, showing the wide range of shots he has.
On the shorter side and on the body, Carey ducks under it.
Full and on the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
On the fuller side and on off, Smith finds the fielder at mid off with a drive.
Length and on off, Carey pushes it through covers for one.
Carlos Brathwaite is back!
Loopy and full on off, Carey drives it on the bounce and past the cover fielder for another single in this over. 8 from Nurse's first.
Steve has played it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fine stop at the cover region! Too full and outside off, Smith strokes it firmly and Russell inside the circle makes a superb stop diving to his right.
Takes this one on the full and pushes it down to long on for one.
FOUR! Well stroked! Nurse delivers a full ball around off, from 'round the wicket, Carey brings out the reverse sweep without waiting any time and nails it behind point for a boundary.

Smith survives the first ball! A flighted ball landing full outside off, Steve stretches out to drive it through the line but it turns and takes the inside edge. The ball goes very closely past the leg stump and they cross for a run as the short fine leg fielder cuts it off.
Ashley Nurse is into the attack for the first time today.
A dot to end! Length and outside off, left alone.
Goes short and on the body, Carey tucks it fine on the leg side and takes two. 50-run stand comes up between this pair!
Another delightful cover drive but to the man at covers. A little to the left or the right and it would have been another boundary.
FOUR! Creamed! Scoring in boundaries is Carey here. His 6th boundary in the 31 he has scored. Full and on off, Carey leans into it and strokes it through covers for a boundary.
Good fielding! Full and on off, Smith strokes it towards mid off who makes a tumbling stop. Can't stop the single though.
Good length on off, it is kept out.
Bangs it short again and Carey once again ducks under it. A better over for the Windies. Just the three from it.
Back of a length and outside off, Smith guides it down to third man for a single.
Another short ball and this one is again on middle, Smith ducks under it.
Very good running again! Carey taps it beside the pitch and takes one.
This is a good short ball, it is on middle. Carey ducks under it.
Smith once again shuffles across and works it towards square leg and takes one.
Good length and on off, Carey defends it to covers. 9 from this over as well.
Another single! Smith works it through mid-wicket and takes one.
Good running! Finally some intent can be seen in the running between the wickets from the Australians. Length and on off, Carey taps it towards covers and gets to the other end.
BEATEN! Length and outside off, Carey looks to defend but gets beaten. He went chasing for a ball he should have left there.
Three now! Full and a little too straight, Smith works it through mid-wicket and takes three.

FOUR! Fortunate, very fortunate boundary for Smith. He could have easily been making the long walk back. Cottrell slipped just at the right time for Australia. Holder bowls this short and on middle, this one gets big on Smith. He looks to pull but the ball goes off the top edge towards deep backward square leg. Sheldon, at fine leg, runs across to his left, then realizes he has to come forward but in an attempt to do so, he slips. The ball lands in front of him and goes past him to find the fence.
Jason Holder is back into the attack.

FOUR! Off the front foot this time! 5th boundary for Carey in the space of 9 balls. He has made up for all the dots at the start of his innings. Full and on off, Carey caresses it through covers. 24 from the last two overs. Has the momentum shifted?
Shuffles right across and works it through square leg for one.
A single now! Very good batting! Good length and on off, it is dropped towards cover for one.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for Carey once again! Sheldon bowls it short and wide again outside off, Carey says thank you very much as he cuts it over point for a boundary.

FOUR! Up and over! Short and outside off, it was asking to be hit! Carey slaps it over point and it races away to the fence. That first boundary might have broken the shackles for Carey. 100 up for Australia.
Back of a length on off, defended again.
Sheldon Cottrell is back!
Good single now! 10 from the over! Carey taps it beside the pitch. Smith calls for a run. Carey responds well and they complete it.
FOUR! Second boundary for Carey! A slight misfield one can say! Full and on off, Carey hits it firmly towards mid off where the fielder dives but lets it through.
Well bowled! This bumper is a lot closer to the off pole, Carey nicely moves out of the way.
FOUR! Well controlled! Welcome boundary for Australia. Shortish and on off, Carey arches and guides it over the gully fielder for a boundary to the third man fence.
Well fielded! Good fielding will only build pressure on the Aussies. Length and around off, Carey strokes it on the up towards cover where the fielder makes a good diving stop.
On the pads, Smith works it through mid-wicket for one.
A maiden! Shortish and on middle, Alex blocks it down onto the ground.
Make that 5 dots! Short and on the body, Carey defends it onto the ground.
Goes short again on middle, Carey stands tall and keeps it out. 4 dots in the over.
On the body of Carey who works it to mid-wicket.
Slightly fuller this time, Carey guides it to point. Runs very hard to come by at the moment.
Continues bowling it on a back of a length. Carey defends it onto the ground.
Just over! Full and outside off, Carey pushes hard at the delivery. The ball flies off the outer half, over point and down towards third man for one.
Very full and on the pads, Smith flicks it nicely through square leg for one.
Back of a length on middle, Smith pushes it to mid on.
Shorter and outside off, Carey gets on top the bounce nicely and guides it to third man for one.
Good length again and outside off, it is left alone.
A low full toss on off, Carey hits it straight to the fielder at mid off.

That did not bounce a lot! Short and angling into the body. This one does not bounce as the other bouncers have done till now. Smith does well not only to duck under it but also, to move out of the way. Another tight over by Holder comes to an end.
Carey finally is off the mark on the 15th ball! Short and on the body, he works it with soft hands towards square leg for one.
On the off pole, Carey defends it out again. Carey is yet to get off the mark.
Goes length this time and outside off, AC shoulders arms to it.
Back of a length again on middle, Carey defends it onto the ground.
Back of a length on off and angling away. Carey guides it to point.
Change of ends for Jason Holder.
A dot to end! Short and on off, Smith stands tall and keeps it out.
WIDE! Add another one to the extras column. Short and this one bounces way too high. Wided.
Well fielded! Saves a run atleast! A rib-tickler! Smith works it towards backward square leg where Pooran dives to his right and stops it.
WIDE! Down the leg side and it has been wided.
Another back of a length ball on off, Smith goes back and pushes it to mid off.
On the pads this time and the length is shorter. Smith nudges it to backward square leg.
Full again on middle, Smith strokes it back to the bowler, who does not stop it cleanly but the batters don't take a run.
Full and on off, Smith drives it nicely to mid off.
Oshane Thomas is back!
A dot to end! Just one from this over. Good length and on off, Carey defends.
Shortish and outside off, left alone.

In the air... safe! Heart-in-the-mouth moment for Australia. Length and on off, it once again comes back in. Carey looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball lobs back towards the bowler but lands just short.
Back of a length on middle, Carey works it to mid-wicket.

NOT OUT! The impact is just fine but the ball is going over the stumps! West Indies lose their review. Never looked like it would be overturned though. Length around off and this one comes back in. Carey looks to defend but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Windies review. Replays show that the on-field call is the right one.
Review time! An appeal for an LBW has been turned down. West Indies have reviewed. Impact seems to be outside off.
Fuller on middle, Smith strokes it past Brathwaite and towards mid on for one.
Very short and outside off, Carey makes his 4th leave. A maiden wicket for Holder.
Continues bowling it outside off, Carey makes another leave.
Another length ball outside off, Carey shoulders arms once again.
Well bowled, well left! Length and around off, it takes off after pitching. Carey does well to leave it after taking his hands away.
Good length and angling away from the left-hander. Carey lets it be.
Alex Carey is the new batsman in.

OUT! The skipper strikes! Stoinis is making the long walk back at the wrong time for Australia. The partnership was going along so well. They just needed this to continue. Another short one and on middle, Marcus looks to pull but gets it off the higher portion of the bat. It goes straight to Pooran at mid-wicket who takes a dolly. West Indies continue to be on top.
FOUR! That is just a mere push! Lovely! Back of a length and width on offer. Smith stands tall and pushes it through covers. It races away. Spoils a maiden.
On the middle pole, Smith keeps it out.
Short again and Smith easily ducks under it.
Another back of a length on off, Smith taps it towards the off side and thinks of a run but is sent back as the fielder at point gets to the ball very quickly.
Back of a length on off, Smith pushes it back to mid off.
Behind a length on middle, Smith looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads. A muted appeal from the bowler but nothing from the umpire.
Nicely worked again through square leg for one.
The short ball ploy continues and it is on the body, Smith lets it go through to the keeper.
On the stumps, Smith shuffles across and keeps it out.
Slightly short but this does not bounce at a very good height. Stoinis easily works it through square leg for one.
Shortish and on the body, Smith pulls it down to fine leg for one.
Back of a length on off, Smith guides it to point.

DRINKS! West Indies well on top with 4 wickets in Powerplay 1. Australia have been caught dancing to the tunes but the pitch seems to have eased out now and the short stuff does not have that much venom as it had in the earlier overs. The ball getting softer is making life easier for the batsmen and Australia will hope that Stoinis and Smith bat longer. Will West Indies be able to stop the recovery or will we witness a fightback?
A single to end! Short and on middle, Smith pulls it all along the ground through square leg for a single.
Goes short again! This might be getting a little too predictable. Smith easily lets it go over him.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Smith looks to flick but misses.
Another short one, Smith spots it early and ducks under it.
Good running! Yes, the boundaries are coming but rotating the strike is very important. Back of a length on off, it is tapped towards the leg side for a run.
On the pads, Smith looks to work it on the leg side but it goes off the pads and down towards fine leg. A run taken. No signal from the umpire so there will be bat involved.
On off, Smith goes back and keeps it out.
Two dots to end a productive over for Australia. Good length on off again, it is blocked.
Drag his length back and Stoinis keeps it out.
FOUR! This is even better than the last one! Full and on middle, Stoinis with a straight bat hits it down to the long on fence. Consecutive boundaries.

FOUR! In the air but away from the fielder! Slightly fuller and on off, Stoinis pushes at it with hard hands. It goes uppishly past the bowler, beats the diving mid off fielder. Brathwaite from mid on gives it a chase, he dives but his effort goes in vain.
Fuller and on off, Marcus drives it back to the bowler.
Good length and on middle, Stoinis defends it out.
Jason Holder brings himself into the attack.

FOUR! Trademark Smith! Slightly shorter and it is outside off, Smith waits for it and guides it through point for a boundary. So Australia have managed to score a boundary in each of the last three overs.
Bangs it short and on the body, Smith ducks under it.
On the pads again, Stoinis flicks it through backward square leg for another single.
Length and on off, Stoinis pushes it towards cover-point.
This is on the pads, Smith works it through backward square leg for one.
Back of a length on off, Smith stands tall and keeps it out.
Another short one on middle, Stoinis once again hops and defends it onto the ground. So despite going for a boundary, just 6 from the over.
Another fiery short one and on the stumps, Stoinis nicely backs away.
Back of a length this time, MS guides it to point.
Good short one on off, Stoinis hops and keeps it out.
Another wide! Short and outside off, Stoinis watches it go through to the keeper. Wided.
On middle, Smith shuffles right across and works it through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Another gift! Full toss, Smith just stands tall and pushes it through mid on and the ball races away to the fence. Australia dealing in boundaries now.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Four fielders will be outside the circle till the 40th over if the innings lasts till then.

FOUR! Nicely pulled! Second boundary in the over! Short and Brathwaite's pace won't trouble Stoinis. He goes back and pulls it behind square for a boundary. A good 10th for Australia but Powerplay 1 belongs to West Indies. The Aussies are 48 for 4.
Back of a length again on middle, MS works it towards mid-wicket.
Extra bounce! Back of a length on middle, Stoinis looks to defend off the back foot but the ball hits the sticker and goes towards point.
Well left! This is just outside off, Marcus knows where his off stump is and he shoulders arms to it.
FOUR! Easy-peasy! A low full toss on middle, Stoinis shows the full face of the bat and drives it through mid on. Welcome boundary for Australia.
This is angled into the batter, Stoinis works it towards mid-wicket.
Carlos Brathwaite is on now!
Back of a length on off, Smith pushes it to covers. Another good over from Russell.
Another one on the shorter side and on middle, Smith evades it. This has also been wided as it is too short. It was a real effort delivery as Russell was on the ground after bowling it.
A full toss and Smith misses out there. He flicks it straight to the fielder at square leg.
This is a wide! This is way too down the leg side, Smith lets it go again and it has been wided.
On the body again, Smith works it to leg gully.
Another short one, this is down the leg side. Smith lets it go through. Not wided.
Bumper on middle, Smith ducks under it.
This is angled into the batsman, it is worked to mid-wicket.
BEAUTY! But well played too! On a length and around off, it goes away late. Stoinis initially looks to defend but then bails out at the very end. Another lovely over from SC comes to an end.
Good length and on middle, Stoinis keeps it out.
Marcus Stoinis is the next batsman in.

OUT! In the air... taken! Maxwell is bounced out! This is vintage pace bowling from the Windies bowler. Australia in dire straits at the moment. This is short and outside off, Maxwell is done in by the pace. He is late on the pull. The ball goes off the top edge to the left of the keeper who moves there and takes it.
Back of a length and on off, Maxwell keeps it out.

Back of a length and outside off, Smith hits it through point. Third man runs to his right and keeps it down to one. The third man seems to be very square for Simth. They know he is strong through there. West Indies have done their homework well.
WIDE! Short and down the leg side. It has been wided.
Back of a length on middle, Smith works it towards mid-wicket.
Glenn Maxwell is the new batsman in.

OUT! WHAT A CATCH! We saw de Kock taking a blinder yesterday, today Shai Hope grabs one. Khawaja's uncomfortable stay out there comes to an end. He looks to break free by stepping out, expecting a short ball but it is a length one. He ends up being too far from the ball and gets a thick outside edge behind. The ball is dying in front of the keeper and first slip but Shai Hope dives to his left and takes it with one hand! Three down are Australia in Powerplay 1. The Windies are pumped. End of another successful over for them.
OUCH! Khawaja is not comfortable against the short balls here. It is a bumper and on the body of Khawaja. He looks to pull but gets hit on the hand and the ball rolls towards the off side.

A half-chance! The plan of bowling short to Khawaja almost worked. Short and on the body, Khawaja pulls it by taking his eyes off. It goes upppishly and past backward short leg and towards fine leg for two.
Loose stroke! Full and wide outside off, UK throws his hands at it away from the body but gets beaten.
Good length and on middle, Khawaja goes back and defends it out.
Shortish and outside off, Smith stands tall and plays it towards third man for one.
Andre Russell is into the attack.
Once again, continues bowling it on a length and around off, Khawaja blocks it out. Just the single from the over. Excellent from Cottrell.
Another back of a length ball on off, Khawaja defends it off the back foot. So West Indies have bowled with a lot of control after the first two overs.
Well played! This pitches on off and then shapes away a little. Smith opens the face of the bat at the end and guides it down to third man for one.
Another back of a length ball on off, Smith gets right behind the line and keeps it out.
Another one shorter in length and on off, Smith taps it towards cover. Khawaja wants a run but is sent back.
Bends his back on this one and bowls it shorter on off, Smith stands tall and defends it onto the ground.
FOUR! Good shot. Thomas bowls a short ball on leg, Khawaja pulls it towards fine leg for a boundary.
On a good length on off, Khawaja looks to defend but gets a bottom edge on this one.

Length delivery on middle, Smith flicks it through square leg. Sheldon Cottrell runs to his left and throws the ball awkwardly at the bowler's end. There were two on offer there but for some reason, Australia take just one.

A bye for Australia. Outside off, on a length, moving away, Khawaja looks to push but the ball does not carry to the keeper. Shai Hope gets a bad bounce and the ball goes off his pads behind. A single taken.
Full on off, Khawaja looks to drive but it goes off the inner half of the bat towards mid-wicket.
On a good length on middle, Khawaja defends it off the back foot.
Steve Smith is the new batsman in.

OUT! There goes another! Cottrell strikes this time. Brilliant, brilliant from the West Indies bowlers. They started off really badly but their second overs have been excellent. Both the openers back in the hut for Australia and they are in trouble here. It is on a length and outside off. Warner is guilty of going hard at it. He plays at the ball ahead of his body. It goes off the outer half and into the hands of point where Hetmyer takes a dolly.
WIDE! Yes, it is an extra but it is a good bumper. Bounces just above the batsman's head.
Another one on the pads, Khawaja flicks it but towards deep square leg only for one.
Back of a length and on middle, Khawaja hops and keeps it out.
Very full but on the pads, Warner clips it through square leg and takes one.
Good length and on off, Warner keeps it out.
This is angled into the pads, Khawaja works it through backward square leg for one.

Very good follow-up delivery by Oshane Thomas. Length delivery on off, Khawaja plays it towards point for a single. An interesting over from Oshane Thomas. 7 runs and a wicket have come from the over.
NASTY! Brute of a delivery that. Short and it is very well-directed. It is at 140 KPH. Khawaja looks to fend at it awkwardly but is hit on the helmet.
The physio is out to have a look! Khawaja seems fine to continue though.
WIDE! Bowls a bouncer, Khawaja does well to duck under it. The umpire signals wide for height.
FOUR! That is a nice way to get going. Fuller in length from Thomas, Khawaja comes forward and drives it down the ground. Two men chase after it, from mid on and mid off but do not get to it at all.
Length delivery on off, Khawaja plays it to point.
WIDE! Bowls a short delivery down the leg side, Khawaja offers no shot to this one.
Usman Khawaja is the new batsman in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Oshane Thomas bowls an absolute beauty to get rid of the Aussie skipper. He lands this on off and then gets it to straighten. Finch is squared up as he tries to defend. The ball kisses the outside edge and goes into the hands of the keeper. Early breakthrough for West Indies.
BEATEN! Thomas bowls it on a good length and outside off, Finch looks to drive but misses it due to lack of foot movement on this one.
Good short one on middle, Finch looks to pull but it hurried into the shot. He mistimes it towards square leg for one.
Well bowled! Back of a length on off, Finch guides it to point.
A full toss on off, Finch hits it onto the ground, gets it over point for a couple. This is a very wayward start by the Windies bowlers.
Slips this on the pads, Warner looks to flick but misses. The ball hits the pads and rolls towards square leg. A leg bye taken.
Back of a length on off, Warner stands tall and defends it out.
Full ball and tailing back in on the pads, Finch flicks it nicely and on the bounce to the deep square leg fielder. One taken.
Sheldon Cottrell to bowl from the other end.
Three good deliveries to end a very good one first over for Australia. On a length and around off, Finch pushes it towards mid off for a quick run.
Another good ball! Back of a length and on off, Finch looks to force it through the off side but is beaten by the extra bounce.
Better! Gets his length right and lands it outside off, Finch lets it be.

Well fielded! Short and on middle, Warner pulls it hard towards mid on. Brathwaite there dives to his left, spills the catch but saves four. Had he taken it, it would not have made a difference as it was a Free Hit. Just the single from the freebie.

NO BALL! Thomas has overstepped! This is not a good start for the West Indies. This is a good ball though. Full and tailing back in on middle, Warner looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. Free Hit coming up!
Finch is off the mark too! Oshane goes full and outside off, Finch reaches out for it but the ball goes off the outer half towards third man for one.
Warner is underway! Back of a length on off, Warner guides it down to third man. The fielder there fumbles but does not concede the second.

FIVE WIDES! Dreadful start for West Indies. Bonus for Australia. Oshane bowls this down the leg side, it swings away further. Warner looks to flick but misses by a long way. Hope dives to his right but can only get a hand to it. It races to the fine leg fence.

Done and dusted with the National Anthems! We are all set for the game to begin! The Australian openers, Aaron Finch and David Warner, make their way out to the middle. The left-hander will take strike and he will be facing Oshane Thomas who has the first new ball in hand. Here we go...
It is time for the National Anthems! The two teams make their way out for it.

Australia (UNCHANGED PLAYING XI) - Aaron Finch (C), David Warner, Usman Khawaja, Steve Smith, Glenn Maxwell, Marcus Stoinis, Alex Carey (WK), Nathan Coulter-Nile, Pat Cummins, Mitchell Starc, Adam Zampa.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Chris Gayle, Evin Lewis, Shai Hope (WK), Nicholas Pooran, Shimron Hetmyer, Andre Russell, Jason Holder (C), Carlos Brathwaite, Ashley Nurse, Sheldon Cottrell, Oshane Thomas.

Aaron Finch says he wanted to bat first as it looks a dry wicket and he hopes it spins later. States there is more confidence in the group and people have stepped up when needed and it has made a difference. Mentions the team has changed completely and today it is about turning up. Informs they have no changes.

Jason Holder says it is a good wicket, there should be something for the pacers early on and he hopes to get early wickets. Mentions the wicket should not change a lot and they need to be disciplined in all the departments. Stresses they need to be aggressive like they were in the first game. Informs Evin Lewis comes in for Darren Bravo. Ends by saying it was a tough choice but Evin has been an important part of the team and hence, he comes in.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in the favor of West Indies. They will bowl first.

PITCH REPORT - Michael Holding says there is a little bit of grass on the surface. Mentions it is a used pitch but the cracks have not opened up. States it looks a belter. Reckons the ball should come onto the bat nicely.

A warm welcome to Match 10 of the 2019 World Cup between Australia and West Indies at Trent Bridge, Nottingham. Both the teams enter this game on the back of a win. However, the sides are probably in for a tougher test today. Australia are favourites but judging by how the Windies played in the first game, you can't rule them out. Let us hope for another exciting encounter.
